data.long_meaning: Rukhaa is an Arabic name derived from the word 'rukh' meaning wind. It is believed to symbolize the gentle breeze that carries the scent of heaven, bringing peace and tranquility. It also refers to the breeze that carries the stars in the night sky, inspiring wonder and curiosity. The name Rukhaa carries the meaning “Heavenly breeze, gentle wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rukhaa usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly breeze, gentle wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
